explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/583 (Erdős–Gallai / Gallai's path decomposition conjecture): every connected graph on n vertices can be partitioned into at most ⌈n/2⌉ edge-disjoint paths. The Lean statement, for any finite type V and connected G, gives a Finset D of subgraphs each traced by a path (IsPathSubgraph: H = p.toSubgraph for a walk with IsPath), with IsDecomposition G D (pairwise disjoint edge sets whose union is G.edgeSet) and |D| ≤ ⌈|V|/2⌉. Paths with no edges are harmless (they only increase |D|), and G.Connected forces V nonempty. Faithful.
